description_en: Queries the major and minor version information of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance, as well as the release notes for the minor version
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的大版本和小版本信息，同时可查询到小版本的发布日志信息
name: DescribeEngineVersion

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

DBLatestMinorVersion.description_en: The information about the latest minor version to which the instance can be upgraded
DBLatestMinorVersion.description_zh: 该实例当前可升级至最新的小版本信息

Level.description_en:
The importance level of the version change. Valid values:
0: Normal.
1: Important.
2: Critical
Level.description_zh:
版本变更的重要性，取值：
0：一般重要
1：比较重要
2：非常重要

VersionRelease.description_en: The version evolution path from the current minor version of the instance to the latest minor version. This is consistent with the version documentation. You can refer to the version release notes for more detailed information
VersionRelease.description_zh: 从实例当前小版本到最新小版本的版本演进路线，与版本文档一致，可以直接至版本说明文档查看更详细的信息

VersionChangesLevel.description_en:
The importance level of the version upgrade (recommended upgrade level). Valid values:
0: Normal.
1: Important.
2: Critical
VersionChangesLevel.description_zh:
版本升级的重要性（推荐升级程度），取值：
0：一般重要
1：比较重要
2：非常重要

DBVersionRelease.description_en: The update notes for the minor version of the instance, including the release time, minor version number, type (such as new feature), and detailed description
DBVersionRelease.description_zh: 实例小版本的更新说明，包含发布时间、小版本号、类型（例如新特性）及详细说明等信息

EnableUpgradeMajorVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the major version of the instance can be upgraded. Valid values:
true: The major version can be upgraded.
false: The major version cannot be upgraded, usually because it is already the latest version.

To upgrade the major version, call the [ModifyInstanceMajorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html） operation
EnableUpgradeMajorVersion.description_zh:
实例是否可升级大版本，返回值：
true：可升级。
false：不可升级，通常已经是最新版本。

如需升级大版本，请调用[ModifyInstanceMajorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html）接口

EnableUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the minor version of the instance can be upgraded. Valid values:

true: The minor version can be upgraded.
false: The minor version is already the latest and cannot be upgraded. 

To upgrade the minor version, call the [ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html） operation
EnableUpgradeMinorVersion.description_zh:
实例是否可升级小版本，返回值：

true：可升级。
false：已经是最新版本，不可升级。 

如需升级小版本，请调用[ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html）接口

Engine.description_en: The database engine type. Valid values: redis and memcache

IsAutoUpgradeOpen.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic minor version upgrade is enabled. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
IsAutoUpgradeOpen.description_zh:
是否开启了小版本自动升级，取值：

0：未开启。
1：开启

IsLatestVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the minor version of the instance is the latest. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
IsLatestVersion.description_zh:
实例的小版本是否为最新，返回值：
true：是。
false：不是

IsNewSSLMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the new TLS version is supported. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
IsNewSSLMode.description_zh:
是否支持新版TLS，取值：
1: 开启
0: 关闭

IsOpenNGLB.description_en:
Indicates whether NGLB mode is enabled. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
IsOpenNGLB.description_zh:
是否开启NGLB模式，取值：
0：未开启。
1：开启

IsRedisCompatibleVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the instance is a Redis-compatible version

IsSSLEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL is enabled. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
IsSSLEnable.description_zh:
是否启用SSL，取值：
1: 开启
0: 关闭

MajorVersion.description_en: The major version of the instance

MinorVersion.description_en: The current minor version of the instance

ProxyLatestMinorVersion.description_en: The information about the latest minor version to which the proxy node can be upgraded
ProxyLatestMinorVersion.description_zh: 该Proxy节点当前可升级至最新的小版本信息

Level.description_en:
The importance level of the version change. Valid values:
0: Normal.
1: Important.
2: Critical
Level.description_zh:
版本变更的重要性，取值：
0：一般重要
1：比较重要
2：非常重要

VersionRelease.description_en: The version evolution path from the current minor version of the instance to the latest minor version. This is consistent with the version documentation. You can refer to the version release notes for more detailed information
VersionRelease.description_zh: 从实例当前小版本到最新小版本的版本演进路线，与版本文档一致，可以直接至版本说明文档查看更详细的信息

VersionChangesLevel.description_en:
The importance level of the version upgrade (recommended upgrade level). Valid values:
0: Normal.
1: Important.
2: Critical
VersionChangesLevel.description_zh:
版本升级的重要性（推荐升级程度），取值：
0：一般重要
1：比较重要
2：非常重要

ProxyMinorVersion.description_en:
The current minor version of the proxy node.
This parameter is returned only for instances of the cluster or read/write splitting architecture
ProxyMinorVersion.description_zh:
Proxy代理节点当前的小版本。
仅集群与读写分离架构实例返回本参数

ProxyVersionRelease.description_en:
The update notes for the minor version of the proxy node, including the release time, minor version number, type (such as new feature), and detailed description.
This parameter is returned only for instances of the cluster or read/write splitting architecture
ProxyVersionRelease.description_zh:
Proxy代理节点的小版本更新说明，包含发布时间、小版本号、类型（例如新特性）及详细说明等信息。
仅集群与读写分离架构实例返回本参数
ProxyVersionRelease.example: {\"releaseInfo\":[{\"createTime\":\"2021-06-08\",\"level\":0,\"releaseVersion\":\"6.6.2\",\"releaseNote\":\"新特性：增加对部分内部命令的支持。\"}],\"versionChangesLevel\":2}
